axiom 7 contextual inference: relevant unstated information may be inferred from available context according to ordinary human reasoning

the prospect had one message from me and zero history

they never emailed to confirm either guess

i rewrote the follow ups with capitals before lunch

this post stayed lowercase because x ran a different inference

11121243.originalText:
four ravens tried to knock a buzzard out of the sky this afternoon

i was standing in the kitchen watching it circle when they came in from the left and hit it one after another

and watching it i realized the whole fight was a live demo of something i wrote down as an axiom this week

axiom 1 emotion direction: every emotion is an internal response that directs energy toward or away from a target and the target and direction are what give the emotion its name

the ravens threw every bit of their energy straight AT the buzzard

meanwhile the buzzard folded its wings and dropped behind the rooftops with all of its energy going away from them

same sky and the same thirty seconds and two completely different emotions running on each side

the axiom put every emotion inside the one responding so the event itself carried zero emotion

the emotion lived entirely in which way each animal was moving relative to the other

the axiom said every emotion so it covered people the exact same way

hand two guys the same harsh comment and one of them walks straight back into the conversation to argue the point while the other one stops replying for a week

the comment was identical and the direction split them

so when someone says a situation made them angry the situation is the wrong place to look

find the target and find which way the energy went

find me one emotion with no target and no direction and the axiom breaks

nobody has found one yet

11121244.originalText:

it pulled every single entry i ever wrote every time i opened it

233 days and over fifteen thousand entries came down in one shot and added up to 4480kb

vercel cuts you off at 4500kb

so i rebuilt it to send only the last month and load older stuff when i scroll back to it and search runs on the server now so it still finds everything

the page opened instantly after that and the loading screen i stared at every morning for months disappeared

and the weird part is i never noticed how slow it was until it was gone

i got used to the wait because i was the only person using it and i HAD to use it

they owe you nothing and they have three other tabs open

most slow websites are slow for the same reason my app was

the owner shoved every photo and every video and the whole portfolio onto the homepage at original size because more looked like more

a stranger on a phone with two bars got a white screen for four seconds and went back to google

you got used to your own loading time

11140204.originalText:
max and i were halfway through a practice ihk exam today and sat at 20 out of 44 points

the sheet had zero columns for almost

axiom 2 standard check: every act of moral or social evaluation compares an action against a standard and lands on met or failed with no third category

grading an exam is that comparison run 44 times

each answer got held against the key and it either matched or it missed

the half understood answer that came close existed in my head and nowhere on the paper

definition of pressure: an external situation where the outcome depends on your performance with negative consequences for failure

the real exam carries those consequences

today ran the identical comparison with the consequences removed

so every failed state on that sheet is the exact verdict the real exam would have handed out and it cost us nothing to receive it

which makes a low practice score the real verdict delivered with the one ingredient the definition of pressure requires stripped out

and since the standard allows no third category the only way a missed point stops being failed is to meet that standard before the day missing it costs something

find one question on any exam that came back half met

there is none

11158393.originalText:
carried a time estimate around for weeks and the weight vanished in a ten minute call

i owed my project lead a number and kept pushing it back

and i had no idea what number anyone on the team was expecting from me

axiom 3 asymmetric access: a person has direct access to their own standards and zero access to anyone else's until those standards get communicated

definition of pressure: an external situation where the outcome depends on your performance with negative consequences for failure

so walk it through

i knew my own bar for the estimate the second i sat down with it

the bar i was going to be judged against lived in somebody else's head

by axiom 3 the only way into that head is communication and i had skipped it

which meant i was taking a test with an invisible pass mark

every possible failure stayed on the table because i had no way to rule any of them out

so by that definition every one of those failures counted as a negative consequence riding on my performance and the pressure covered all of them the entire time

then she called and said put three days for the responsive work and book the refactor on the maintenance contract

one sentence of her standard and the whole thing shrank down to a task

the work took the same effort before and after that call

the only variable that changed was access

so by axiom 3 the part of the pressure that came from someone else's standard was a missing conversation wearing the costume of a hard problem

find me one case where you knew exactly what someone expected and still sat in that same fog

you will come up with none
